arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-03-01' AND date < '2019-03-16'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated 1 March 2019 through 15 March 2019 inclusive.
assumptions: Date range is 2019-03-01 00:00:00 through 2019-03-15 23:59:59, both days included.
All transactions are counted, including those with no fraud label and those with negative amounts or errors.
